vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --plugin UTRAnnotator,file={corpus}/data/uORF_5UTR_GRCh37_PUBLIC.chr21.txt --dir_plugins {corpus}/data [--tab|--vcf|--json]
vep_environment: PERL_HASH_SEED=0 PERL_PERTURB_KEYS=0: the UTRAnnotator plugin writes the key=value pairs of 5UTR_annotation, the order of its effect groups and, when more than one analysis fires, the chosen 5UTR_consequence in Perl hash order (UTRAnnotator.pm:262-288 at VEP_plugins release/116), so the reference is generated with a fixed hash seed and no key perturbation; the golden tests compare the pairs and groups as a multiset (the order_only mask) and the corpus carries no record on which two analyses fire for one row
plugin: UTRAnnotator (VEP_plugins release/116, UTRAnnotator.pm, the copy the image ships at /plugins); data/uORF_5UTR_GRCh37_PUBLIC.chr21.txt: the header line and the chromosome 21 rows of uORF_5UTR_GRCh37_PUBLIC.txt from https://github.com/Ensembl/UTRannotator (commit 40e30db003d72435eb3744ee747029294abbcf3a, MIT licence), whose sha256 is 4e31d894882bab25f5d65e8af7b7e32c952082e6aad2f6fc00676c6dbbb26745; the slice carries 379 rows
fasta: GRCh37 chromosome 21 at its full length from Homo_sapiens.GRCh37.75.dna.primary_assembly.fa, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N, written at 60 bases per line; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form
input: variants.vcf: 25 hand-placed chromosome 21 records in the 5' UTRs of protein-coding transcripts on both strands, named in the ID column by their design, the transcript they were designed on and the UTR index of the allele: a substitution that creates a start codon (uaug_gained_snv) and an insertion that completes one at the insertion point (uaug_gained_ins_junction); a substitution and a two-base substitution that create a stop codon inside an existing upstream ORF (ustop_gained_snv, ustop_gained_mnv); a substitution that removes an upstream ORF's stop codon (ustop_lost_snv); a substitution that removes a start codon of an upstream ORF (uaug_lost_snv) or of an overlapping ORF (uaug_lost_oorf_snv); a one-base deletion and insertion inside an upstream ORF (uframeshift_del, uframeshift_ins) and inside an overlapping ORF (uframeshift_oorf_ins); the same designs on upstream ORFs the evidence file lists (_ev, Evidence=True); and a deletion of a whole 5' UTR exon (whole_utr_exon_del), which the max-overlap-80 set drops from the analysis. The reference base is the primary assembly's; the corpus carries no row of the documented divergence utrannotator_consequence_precedence
generator: records designed from the JSON cache's 5' UTR sequences and exon models; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; the reference extract and mask described under fasta; the reference runs recorded under vep_command and under each flag_sets entry's vep_command, in the image, PERL_HASH_SEED=0 PERL_PERTURB_KEYS=0; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --dataset utr=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers UTRAnnotator --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --fasta-name reference.fa.gz --flag=--plugin --flag=UTRAnnotator,file={corpus}/data/uORF_5UTR_GRCh37_PUBLIC.chr21.txt --flag=--dir_plugins --flag={corpus}/data; vep-golden-corpus flag-set --name max-overlap-80; masks order_only; vep-golden-corpus classify (the default run and the flag set)

max-overlap-80.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --plugin UTRAnnotator,file={corpus}/data/uORF_5UTR_GRCh37_PUBLIC.chr21.txt,max_overlap=80 --dir_plugins {corpus}/data [--tab|--vcf|--json]
